about: The registry of Lantern implementations (SPEC.md § 17), shown on https://lantern.boreale.dev/implementations/. One entry per implementation, added by a pull request with the conformance suite's report.

implementations.name: Lantern reference server
implementations.note: The text's own reference: a folder of packages and homebrew, served by the protocol, and exported as a static library (--export). A reference, not a product.

implementations.name: Lantern SDK, Python server toolkit
implementations.note: The server half of the Python SDK: a library to add Lantern to an existing application. The SDK's CI runs the conformance suite against it.

implementations.name: Lantern SDK, TypeScript server toolkit
implementations.note: The server half of the TypeScript SDK: a library to add Lantern to a Node or web-standard application. The SDK's CI runs the conformance suite against it.
